## C. Crash gating

**SKIPPED — not measurable on this panel.** The live cache begins in 2023 and contains no momentum crash, so a crash gate scored here would grade itself on a sample with nothing to catch. Re-run with `--closes deep`.

## D. Factor-leg impact (descriptive)

Does adding size / value / quality / low-vol to the regression change anything? **Descriptive on purpose** — the legs only exist on the ~3-year live panel (annual fundamentals), which is far too few rebalances to say anything about predictive power.

Mean residual vol 0.020338 (market+sector) → 0.020675 (with legs) — **-1.66%** of residual volatility absorbed.

| leg | mean abs corr to residual, market+sector | with the leg in |
|---|--:|--:|
| `low_vol` | 0.1502 | 0.1029 |
| `quality` | 0.1015 | 0.0585 |
| `size` | 0.127 | 0.0956 |
| `value` | 0.1317 | 0.1087 |

Sector-neutral score rank correlation between the two constructions: **0.9378** over 1462 names · top-50 overlap 41/50.

A high rank correlation means the extra legs mostly re-express what market+sector already removed; a low one means they change who the leaders are — and would then need their own promotion gate before anything acted on the difference.

**Multiple testing.** 38 candidates logged to the Trial Ledger for family `residual_momentum_phase0`; the Deflated Sharpe reads its n from there rather than a caller-chosen literal.

**Standing prior.** `resid_accel` (residual acceleration) was pre-registered and KILLED in the earlier residual-alpha work (deep-panel IC −0.012, t −2.7) and is carried here as a DIAGNOSTIC only — it is excluded from the quality composite by construction. Re-promoting it needs a fresh pre-registered gate.
